description: An unparenthesized attribute access used as an object key is an evaluation error
notes: The grammar allows any expression as a key and the prose only makes a bare identifier a literal name, so the key would be evaluated and name the attribute x. hashicorp/hcl rejects an unparenthesized traversal with more than one step when it evaluates the key, because it could be meant as a dotted name (ObjectConsKeyExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
